name: Puppy Truck
description:
About This Game

What’s a Puppy Truck?

Kid has one big birthday wish: a puppy, but Parents say no. Grandma, a world class inventor, steps up to build the next best thing: Puppy Truck! A tiny truck with the heart of a puppy.

Set off on a bite-sized adventure through a house full of playful obstacles and quirky contraptions as Puppy Truck, an adorable miniature truck-pup. Use your wheel-paws to climb, dash, and scramble through every room, solving puzzles and tinkering with Grandma’s inventions to make it to Kid’s birthday party on time.

Yes, you can drift the dog!

Climb, run, dash, scramble, scamper, slide, and flip - Puppy Truck is the dog that does it all. Enjoy full freedom of control in this 3D platformer with tons of movement options!

Open-world puzzles with multiple solutions!

Traverse 4 robust levels filled with different objectives that can be approached any way you want! Uncover hidden areas with plenty of goofs and gags along the way.

Explore a world full of contraptions and creatures created by an eccentric inventor!

Explore Granny's house, filled with her many "intelligent" creations. Once an inventor at HACME Corporation, she was encouraged to take an early retirement after her life's work adding "smart" features resulted in products discovering hobbies, vastly preferring them to their intended purpose. Puppy Truck, her finest creation has been loaded into the shipping contraption to be shrunk, packaged, and shipped off to her grandchild just in time for their birthday. Hope nothing goes wrong there!

Features

  • 4 massive open levels — rich environments packed with puzzles, contraptions, and surprises

  • Fluid dog schmovement — slide through the house, boost between objectives, and hover to extend your airtime

  • Hats! — unlock cosmetics to customize your Puppy Truck

  • Objectives and collectibles — plenty to tackle and discover throughout Grandma’s eclectic house

  • Secrets to uncover — hidden goofs and surprises tucked into every corner
short_desc: Puppy Truck is a puzzle-packed 3D platforming adventure about a tiny truck with the heart of a puppy! Explore Grandma’s eclectic house, filled with contraptions, challenges, and surprises as you race to make it to the birthday party on time.
